title: Armed conflict
label: CIVILIAN SAFETY
deck: A civilian plan for shelter, communication, displacement, and unexploded hazards.
tldr: If fighting is nearby, get away from windows and exposed areas and follow trustworthy local shelter or evacuation instructions. Keep people together, identify a safe place and a contact outside the area, and carry essential medication and documents if you must leave. Never touch an unfamiliar munition or suspicious debris.
steps: Move away from windows and exterior openings to a sturdy interior space when travel is unsafe. If authorities direct an evacuation and the route is safe, follow it.
Agree on a meeting point and an out-of-area contact. Write down important numbers; phone and data service may fail.
Keep identification, medication, water, phone power, weather-appropriate clothing, and children’s essentials accessible. Check current routes and shelter options before departure.
Do not approach, handle, or move unexploded objects. Keep others away and report the location through local authorities when safe.
next: If abroad, check your country's embassy or consular crisis messages; do not assume transport or evacuation will be provided. Reassess each movement against current conditions rather than an old map or rumor.
watch: This is civilian protective guidance, not a movement order. The safest choice can change quickly with the location, time, and instructions from responsible authorities.
